children: Rain Enhancement Technologies entered into a binding letter of intent to pursue an all-stock business combination with Tensor Networks. On closing, both Rain Enhancement Technologies and Tensor Networks would operate as wholly owned subsidiaries under the public holding company, with Tensor shareholders expected to own about 90% of the combined company before any PIPE financing. The deal is subject to definitive agreements, shareholder approvals, Nasdaq listing approvals, at least $25 million in concurrent financing, completion of Rain's Class B conversion, and debt restructuring. There is no assurance the transaction will close.
: Binding letter of intent for all-stock business combination
: Through outside date Nov 20 2026, earlier termination permitted
